column-selection-1:1569.description: Select the column containing measured, non redundant list of m/z values

string-input-1:1585.description: Absolute path to the Python3 executable; do not change unless you want to use your own python environment outside the KNIME_docker_vnc container

string-input-1:1584.description: path to the file to be written containing the optimized DIA windows in the appropriate format; the extension is based on the target machine (timsTOF Pro machines: txt; Orbitrap machines: csv)

int-input-1:1581.description: number of serial ion mobility steps during the PASEF scan; please note that the number of windows has to be divisible by the numer of steps! 2 steps means that all ions will be released from the TIMS cell onto the quadrupole in two steps, splitting the ion mobility range into two not overlapping parts; the algorithm will optimize the individual DIA windows ion mobility ranges based on the provided info

double-input-1:1582.description: minimal value to be used for the optimized DIA windows

double-input-1:1580.description: individual DIA windows overlap on the m/z range; this value will be added to the upper m/z range limit of each DIA window; this value is ignored for overlapping (staggered) windows schemes where it should be 0

variable_value.default: staggered windows design without overlap and ion mobility usage (Orbitraps)

single-selection-1:1568.description: Specify what DIA windows design you would like to get

example.variable_value: staggered windows design without overlap and ion mobility usage (Orbitraps)

int-input-1:1572.description: Number of DIA windows to make; please note that in case of overlapping DIA windows, the number of actually generated windows will be the specified number x2 +1

string-input-1:1570.description: M/z range to be covered by the DIA windows (e.g. 400-1000) or percentile based on the provided m/z values (e.g. 0.9); percentile value is used to leave out the same number of observations (5% of the values in case of percentile 0.9) from both ends to define the target m/z range

string-input-1:1583.description: maximal value to be used for the optimized DIA windows; use either single value or set of "m/z:1/K0" value pairs separated by semicolon (e.g. "150:0.6; 800:1.2; 1300:1.6")

column-selection-1:1579.description: Select the column containing measured, non redundant list of 1/K0 values
